digest.component_or_area: plan-review G7 criterion routing and impact grading
propositions: G7 criterion blocks at priority >= 0.85 despite carrying default_posture 'advisory' at 0.95 in routing config, causing zero blocking in practice; the routing entry must flip to default_posture 'blocking' with block_threshold 0.85 to match observed FP verification (0 clearly-incorrect findings across 348 historical cases at >= 0.85).

Unresolvable parent tickets (show_ticket fails) emit findings instead of abstaining with coverage, generating false positives; the rubric must enforce fail-open behavior so that unresolvable parents ABSTAIN rather than generate findings.

Duplicate findings for the same contradicted parent clause stack as separate findings rather than deduping into a single finding with combined evidence; the rubric must scope emission to one finding per contradicted parent clause (dedup-at-source pattern).

The G7 rubric lacks explicit guidance that blocking scope covers both contradicts_reality AND omits_required_site floor kinds (impact floor 0.85) while incomplete_enumeration (impact 0.55) remains advisory; a one-sentence kind-mapping guidance statement must clarify that only genuine contract contradictions or provably required omissions constitute blocking-floor kinds.

Closed-parent contracts are checked against intermediate state rather than final state, and sibling handoff scope is incorrectly flagged as a leaf violation; the rubric must specify that closed parents are checked against their final state and that scope explicitly handed to siblings is not a leaf violation.
